name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android QA APK Build + Emulator QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_status }}
      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0 ndk;27.1.12297006 cmake;3.22.1'
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false

      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Expo dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Verify tooling
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          echo "=== Tool versions ==="
          bun --version
          node --version
          npx expo --version

      - name: Prepare QA signing key
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          QA_KEYSTORE="$HOME/.android/debug.keystore"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$QA_KEYSTORE")"
          # Recreate the CI-only signer on every run so a runner image's stale or
          # malformed debug keystore can never be selected for the release candidate.
          rm -f "$QA_KEYSTORE"
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" \
            -storepass android \
            -alias androiddebugkey \
            -keypass android \
            -keyalg RSA \
            -keysize 2048 \
            -validity 10000 \
            -dname "CN=IVX CI QA, OU=Engineering, O=IVX Holdings, L=Miami, ST=Florida, C=US"
          keytool -list -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey >/dev/null
          echo "QA signing key verified. This signer is for QA artifacts only."

      # ============================================================
      # Build a disposable QA APK. Production release signing is isolated from
      # this workflow and never uses this runner-generated debug signer.
      # ============================================================
      - name: Build Android QA APK
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/android
        timeout-minutes: 30
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}

          echo "=== Building disposable QA APK with Gradle ==="
          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"

          ./gradlew assembleQa --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then

          else
            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 400 lines ==="
            tail -400 gradle-build.log
            echo "### Build Failure — Last 400 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            exit 1
          fi

      # ALWAYS run — uploads the full Gradle log even when the build fails.
      - name: Upload Gradle build log

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-android-qa-gradle-log-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
          retention-days: 30

          echo "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Created issue:', d.get('html_url', d.get('message','unknown')))"

      - name: Find built APK

        working-directory: expo/android

name: Android Production Signing

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:

    name: Signed APK and AAB
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Validate protected release signing inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for variable in IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64 IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS IVX_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD; do
            if [ -z "${!variable}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Required protected release-signing input is unavailable: $variable"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          umask 077
          KEYSTORE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/ivx-release.keystore"
          printf '%s' "$IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$KEYSTORE_PATH"
          keytool -list -keystore "$KEYSTORE_PATH" -storepass "$IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS" >/dev/null
          echo "IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PATH=$KEYSTORE_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Release key validated without printing signing material."

      - name: Build signed release APK and AAB
        working-directory: expo/android
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          chmod +x gradlew

          set -euo pipefail

          jarsigner -verify -strict "$AAB"

          path: |
            expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

name: IVX QA Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  qa-suite:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      IVX_WIRE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ivx-ci-wire-encryption-key-v1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9

      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: '1. TypeScript typecheck (backend) — HARD GATE'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd backend && bunx tsc --noEmit
          echo 'backend_typecheck=PASS'

      - name: '2. Backend unit tests — process isolated — HARD GATE'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : > backend-test-results.txt
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.tmp/test-logs"
          failed=0
          count=0
          while IFS= read -r test_file; do
            count=$((count + 1))
            safe_name=$(printf '%s' "$test_file" | tr '/ ' '__')
            test_root="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.tmp/ivx-qa-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}-${count}"
            test_log="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.tmp/test-logs/${safe_name}.log"
            rm -rf "$test_root"
            mkdir -p "$test_root"
            echo "=== $test_file ===" | tee -a backend-test-results.txt
            if ! (cd "$test_root" && IVX_DATA_DIR="$test_root" NODE_ENV=test bun test "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$test_file" --reporter=dots) 2>&1 | tee "$test_log"; then
              cat "$test_log" >> backend-test-results.txt
              failed=$((failed + 1))
              echo "FAILED_FILE=$test_file" | tee -a backend-test-results.txt
            else
              cat "$test_log" >> backend-test-results.txt
            fi
            rm -rf "$test_root"
          done < <(find backend -type f \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -print | sort)
          echo "isolated_test_files=$count failed_files=$failed" | tee -a backend-test-results.txt
          if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "backend_tests=FAIL ($failed/$count test files failed)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'backend_tests=PASS'

      - name: '3. Expo unit tests — process isolated — HARD GATE'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : > expo-test-results.txt
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.tmp/expo-test-logs"
          failed=0
          count=0
          while IFS= read -r test_file; do
            count=$((count + 1))
            safe_name=$(printf '%s' "$test_file" | tr '/ ' '__')
            test_log="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.tmp/expo-test-logs/${safe_name}.log"
            echo "=== $test_file ===" | tee -a expo-test-results.txt
            if ! (cd expo && NODE_ENV=test bun test "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$test_file" --reporter=dots) 2>&1 | tee "$test_log"; then
              cat "$test_log" >> expo-test-results.txt
              failed=$((failed + 1))
              echo "FAILED_FILE=$test_file" | tee -a expo-test-results.txt
            else
              cat "$test_log" >> expo-test-results.txt
            fi
          done < <(find expo -type f \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print | sort)
          echo "isolated_expo_test_files=$count failed_files=$failed" | tee -a expo-test-results.txt
          if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "expo_tests=FAIL ($failed/$count test files failed)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'expo_tests=PASS'

      - name: '4. Critical file protection test — HARD GATE'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun test qa/ivx-critical-file-protection.test.ts --reporter=dots
          echo 'critical_files=PASS'

      - name: '5. QA matrix (production)'
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun run qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts 2>&1 | tee qa-results.txt
          echo 'qa_matrix=PASS'
        env:
          IVX_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          NODE_ENV: ci

      - name: '6. Evidence generation'
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun run qa/ivx-evidence-generator.ts 2>&1 | tee evidence-results.txt
          echo 'evidence_generation=PASS'

      - name: '7. Upload QA results'
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: qa-results
          path: |
            backend-test-results.txt
            expo-test-results.txt
            qa-results.txt
            evidence-results.txt
            qa/latest-run.json
            qa/evidence/latest.json

      - name: '8. Critical files final check — HARD GATE'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun test qa/ivx-critical-file-protection.test.ts --reporter=dots
          echo 'critical_files_final=PASS'

name: IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: TypeScript typecheck — HARD GATE
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install deps (root + expo)
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun install --cwd expo --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Typecheck (root) — HARD GATE
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bunx tsc --noEmit
          echo 'root_typecheck=PASS'
      - name: Typecheck (expo) — HARD GATE
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd expo && bunx tsc --noEmit
          echo 'expo_typecheck=PASS'
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144

  lint:
    name: Lint — HARD GATE
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: cd expo && bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Lint — HARD GATE
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd expo && bun run lint
          echo 'lint=PASS'

  e2e-playwright:
    name: Playwright E2E (web surface) — HARD GATE
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [typecheck]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: cd expo && bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        working-directory: expo
        run: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Run Playwright tests — HARD GATE
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bunx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
          echo 'playwright=PASS'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: expo/playwright-report

  e2e-maestro:
    name: Maestro E2E (mobile surface) — HARD GATE
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [typecheck]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: cd expo && bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Start the Expo development server
        working-directory: expo
        env:
          CI: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          nohup bunx expo start --dev-client --port 8081 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/expo-metro.log" 2>&1 &
          for attempt in {1..30}; do
            if curl --silent --fail http://127.0.0.1:8081/status | grep -q 'packager-status:running'; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/expo-metro.log"
          echo 'Expo dev server failed to start'
          exit 1
      - name: Build and launch the iOS simulator app — HARD GATE
        working-directory: expo
        timeout-minutes: 45
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bunx expo run:ios --configuration debug --no-bundler
          echo 'ios_build=PASS'
      - name: Install Maestro
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
          echo 'maestro_install=PASS'
      - name: Run Maestro launch smoke test — HARD GATE
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ~/.maestro/bin/maestro test expo/.maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-report.xml
          echo 'maestro_test=PASS'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: maestro-report
          path: maestro-report.xml
